title: Reflex (GGUF-native cold-start-optimized inference)
description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, streaming or not, backed by Reflex: a GGUF-native GPU inference engine built for fast cold starts (ahead-of-time compiled CUDA kernels, no runtime JIT). Serves Qwen3-0.6B (Q4_K_M), baked into the image.

input.name: Adapter Arguments
input.description: Extra reflex-openai-adapter flags, space-separated, e.g. "--max-tokens-cap 1024 --default-max-tokens 128". Request limits default to max_tokens 2048, prompt 256 KiB, queue depth 16, timeout 300 s.
